title: Binance Will Open Trading for SUI
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Sui (SUI) and open trading for SUI/BTC, SUI/USDT, SUI/TUSD, SUI/BNB, SUI/EUR and SUI/TRY trading pairs at  2023-05-03 12:15 (UTC) . Notes :  Users will enjoy zero maker fees on the SUI/TUSD trading pair until further notice. EUR and TRY are fiat currencies and do not represent any other digital currencies.
